Specification: This specification models Euclid's algorithm for computing the greatest common divisor, starting from a fixed value 24 and a nondeterministically chosen initial value v in 1..N. The file contains a PlusCal algorithm and its generated TLA+ translation, with control-state variable pc and state variables u, v, and v_ini. The temporal specification requires initialization, stepwise execution with stuttering, and weak fairness of Next, and it asserts eventual termination as well as a final assertion that the result equals GCD(24, v_ini).
FunctionApplication: Assert(v = GCD(24, v_ini), "Failure of assertion at line 9, column 5.")
ChoiceExpr:
CHOOSE i \in (1..x) \cap (1..y) :
                /\ x % i = 0 
                /\ y % i = 0
                /\ \A j \in (1..x) \cap (1..y) :
                        /\ x % j = 0 
                        /\ y % j = 0
                        => i \geq j
